title: 25 Movies That Survive Four Different Roommates
description: The apartment movie-night list — films that work across wildly different tastes, no one vetoes, and nobody's already seen five times.
intro:
Living with people means negotiating everything, and movie night is where taste differences go to fight. The film major wants subtitles. Someone wants to half-watch while texting. Someone's cutoff is 10:30 on a work night. Someone has already seen everything.

This list is built for that apartment. Twenty-five movies that hold up across genuinely different tastes, don't demand full attention to work but reward it if you give it, and stay under the "it's a school night" runtime ceiling.
method: No title over ~2h10. Nothing so niche it needs a film-school preamble, nothing so bland it's forgettable. Heavy weight on low-veto films — the apartment peace treaty matters more than any single person's favorite.
